text:
sam: Opening thread — we're seeing a cluster of SAML validation failures from our APAC IdP between 2025-04-21T18:05Z-18:10Z. SCIM provisioning retries started shortly after and produced duplicate users in staging.

elaine: logs: `AssertionTimestamp: 2025-04-21T18:05:03Z` vs our proxy `now=2025-04-21T18:05:08Z` and validation fail reason `ClockSkewExceeded`. IdP claims clocks in APAC region drifted ~8s after a leap-second sync.

ops-bot: deploy: ntp-sync job ran on proxies at 2025-04-21T18:02Z -config change: enable-ntp-strict.

sam: why would that trigger SCIM duplicates?

matt: chain: failed SAML assertions -> sso-proxy treats as unauthenticated webhook -> provisioning handler falls back to retry/backfill which creates new users when externalId not found. IdP also retries POSTs without cookie sometimes, so duplicates.

elaine: example trace:
```
2025-04-21T18:05:04Z req=x1 SAML validate failed: ClockSkewExceeded (offset=8s)
2025-04-21T18:05:05Z scim POST /scim/Users externalId=ext-900 origin=https://apac-idp.example.com status=401
2025-04-21T18:05:06Z backfill: create user uid=u-900 source=backfill
2025-04-21T18:05:07Z scim POST retry externalId=ext-900 status=201 create uid=u-901
```

oncall-sec: impact? any PII leakage or RBAC bypass?

sam: no evidence of data exfil. RBAC checks are applied later, but audit linking is broken for the backfill-created accounts — audit_events have null correlation_id for those ops.

elaine: repro: simulate clock skew by setting system clock +/- 10s and POST SAML assertion; we see validation flip.

matt: temporary mitigation: relax allowed SAML clock skew in sso-proxy from 5s -> 30s for this deployment group, while we fix IdP NTP and add probes. But compliance will want that documented.

oncall-sec: caution — increasing tolerance expands replay window. Need compensating controls: require SAML Assertion ID replay cache + short validity window and HMAC-signed SCIM webhooks to avoid unauthenticated backfills.

sam: agreed. Immediate plan: 1) roll a canary with skew tolerance to 30s on non-prod clusters, 2) add SAML replay cache enforcement, 3) add IdP NTP healthcheck to rotation runbooks, 4) add alert for scim_create_dup_rate > 0.05.

elaine: creating ticket SEC-8202 for postmortem and mitigation. Also adding a KB entry for on-call: how to detect clock skew-induced assertion failures and run quick mitigations.

matt: DB reconciliation plan: run dedupe where externalId matches and created_at between 2025-04-21T18:04:30Z and 18:12:00Z; map provisioning_req_id to canonical user and update audit_events correlation_id accordingly. Will run with backup snapshot.

audit-bot: noted SEC-8202, SEC-8203 (add SAML replay cache), SEC-8204 (HMAC webhooks).

ops-bot: additional note — our KMS HSM scheduling had a maintenance window earlier which caused a 6s pause in signature verification on some nodes; combine that with NTP jitter could explain spikes. KMS team alerted.

oncall-sec: follow-ups: require KMS maintenance windows to be coordinated with IdP owners, add a post-rotation canary to verify end-to-end auth (SAML login + SCIM webhook) before marking rotation complete. Assign owner: elaine for playbook updates.

sam: rolling canary now to non-prod. Will monitor scim_backfill_dup_rate and saml_clock_skew_errors. Reverting if any increase.

elaine: documenting temp tolerance change and will prepare a tight rollback plan to restore 5s after IdP NTP confirmed. Also planning an opt-in HMAC webhook config for IdPs.

oncall-sec: good. Capture all logs to /var/ops/incidents/7165432100 and attach to SEC-8202. Posting summary to #incidents after postmortem.

sam: thanks team. Closing thread once dedupe & playbook patches are done. :thumbsup:
